author: Claude Opus 5.5 for Daniel Rosehill
status: assumed: weights are judgement calls, not fitted to any measured task accuracy. Every signal is a proxy; none measures the batch job itself.
batch_specific_benchmark: None found (search 2026-10-31). No public leaderboard measures quality against cost on high-volume labelling, extraction or synthetic-data jobs. The only direct measure is your own labelled pilot: cost per correct output.

signals.lmarena_text:<category>: LMArena text arena Elo for one category (text/latest, published 2026-10-28). Human pairwise preference, so it rewards answers people like, not label accuracy.
signals.lmarena_document: LMArena document arena Elo (document/latest, published 2026-09-13): users upload a document and ask about it. Closest available proxy for long-document work. 44 models.
signals.vectara_fcr: Vectara hallucination leaderboard factual consistency rate (%) when summarising a document (README, updated 2026-10-22). Measures faithfulness only, not summary quality.

normalisation.elo: q = 1 / (1 + 10^((median - rating) / 400)), median over the batch models with a score in that signal: the chance of beating the median batch model. 0.5 = median.
normalisation.vectara_fcr: q = (fcr - min) / (max - min) over the batch models with a score, then shrunk to 0.1-0.9 so one signal can't dominate the Elo ones.
normalisation.combine: quality = weighted mean of the signals the model has, weights renormalised over those present. coverage = sum of the weights present. quality is left blank when coverage < 0.5.

variant_rule: Sources list several reasoning-effort variants of one model. For 'reason' the highest-effort variant is used; for every other workload the lowest-effort variant, because the costs in entry 08 assume reasoning off. The chosen variant name is reported in every row.

classify.why: Label jobs fail on format and constraint compliance more than on knowledge.

extract.why: Schema compliance plus handling messy inputs. No maintained JSON-schema benchmark covers current models (JSONSchemaBench last updated 2025-03, StructEval 2025-09).

doc_qa.why: Document arena is the only maintained document-grounded signal without an Artificial Analysis key (AA-LCR would be better).

judge.why: No maintained judge benchmark covers current models (RewardBench 2 results last updated 2025-12). Expert and hard prompts stand in for the discernment grading needs.

translate.why: Non-English prompts as a whole. No Hebrew category exists; Hebrew quality is not measured.

synth.why: Prompt/response pair generation needs varied, natural text that still follows the spec. No maintained synthetic-data or diversity leaderboard exists (AgoraBench last commit 2024-12, NoveltyBench has no leaderboard).

reason.why: Maths and code categories, highest-effort variant.
